Clickbait Title: Kochi Sometimes Plays Itself

Originally a bonus video for patrons March, 2026

An earlier draft of the script directly referenced a Patrick Willems' video about the geography of New York as experienced via film, the way characters move about, and how landmarks are portrayed. However when I went to pull that video I couldn't find it, and after some investigation it turned out the video didn't exist, I was remembering a conversation that Patrick and I had had over lunch when I was in Brooklyn recording Line Goes Up.

Vancouver Never Plays Itself: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ojm74VGsZBU
